sources.title: PnetCDF user guide
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: IOR／mdtest：吞吐、metadata 與快取假象
related.titleEn: IOR/mdtest: throughput, metadata and cache artifacts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：讀回所有筆而非僅檔案存在；速度與完整性分欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Read back every record rather than just checking file existence; separate speed from integrity.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「IOR／mdtest：吞吐、metadata 與快取假象」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付 benchmark 方法表、bytes/ops 原始計數與分開的資料／metadata 指標。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct IOR/mdtest: throughput, metadata and cache artifacts with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver a benchmark-method table, raw bytes/operations and separate data/metadata metrics.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分開計算一百次啟動與一次總資料傳輸，不使用檔案大小當操作數。
將 64 GiB 除共同 8 s，保留每 rank 完成時間以觀察慢尾。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Separate one hundred startups from total transferred bytes; file size is not operation count.
Divide 64 GiB by a common 8 s and retain per-rank completion times to inspect tails.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Lmod 階層模組：編譯器與 MPI 的有效組合
related.titleEn: Lmod hierarchical modules: valid compiler/MPI combinations
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：讀回所有筆而非僅檔案存在；速度與完整性分欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Read back every record rather than just checking file existence; separate speed from integrity.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Lmod 階層模組：編譯器與 MPI 的有效組合」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付模組階層、配對矩陣、乾淨載入及復原紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Lmod hierarchical modules: valid compiler/MPI combinations with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver module hierarchies, pair matrices and clean-load/restore records.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分開計算一百次啟動與一次總資料傳輸，不使用檔案大小當操作數。
將三個有效配對各展開三個app版本，逐一編號。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Separate one hundred startups from total transferred bytes; file size is not operation count.
Expand each of three valid pairs into three app versions and number each environment.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
